review: 701.44b-1: opponents_walker flipped Wildgrowth Walker's 'you control' condition, not whether the creature explored; replaced it with explore_countered (Stifle), adding B's Island and Stifle to the base setup.

scenarios.title: Explore sends a revealed land to hand and otherwise adds a +1/+1 counter

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top card first.

decisions: A casts Merfolk Branchwalker, tapping both Forests; it resolves and enters the battlefield.
Its explore trigger resolves: A reveals the top card of A's library. If the revealed card is not a land, A puts it into the graveyard.

variants.label: nonland_revealed
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is revealed, is not a land, and goes to A's graveyard. Merfolk Branchwalker gets a +1/+1 counter (3/2). A's hand is empty and A's library holds only Forest.

variants.label: land_revealed
variants.delta: The library order is Forest, then Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Forest is revealed and goes to A's hand. Merfolk Branchwalker gets no counter and stays 2/1. A's library holds only Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: nonland_kept_on_top
variants.delta: A leaves the revealed Grizzly Bears on top of the library instead of putting it into the graveyard.
variants.expected: Merfolk Branchwalker gets a +1/+1 counter (3/2). Grizzly Bears stays on top of A's library and A's graveyard is empty.

scenarios.title: A permanent explores even when the reveal is impossible
decisions: A casts Merfolk Branchwalker, tapping both Forests; it resolves and enters the battlefield; its explore trigger goes on the stack.
B passes; the explore trigger resolves. Wildgrowth Walker's trigger, if it fires, resolves afterwards.

variants.label: empty_library
variants.expected: Nothing can be revealed, but Merfolk Branchwalker still explores: it gets a +1/+1 counter (3/2). Wildgrowth Walker's trigger fires, giving Walker a +1/+1 counter (2/4) and A 3 life (23).

variants.label: land_on_top
variants.delta: A's library holds one card, Forest.
variants.expected: Forest is revealed and goes to A's hand; Merfolk Branchwalker gets no counter (2/1). Wildgrowth Walker's trigger still fires: Walker is 2/4 and A is at 23.

variants.label: explore_countered
variants.delta: B casts Stifle targeting the explore trigger, tapping Island, instead of passing.
variants.expected: The explore trigger is countered and Merfolk Branchwalker does not explore: it stays 2/1 with no counter. Wildgrowth Walker's trigger does not fire: Walker stays 1/3 and A's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: A permanent that left the battlefield still explores using last known information

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top card first.

decisions: A casts Merfolk Branchwalker, tapping both Forests; it resolves and enters the battlefield; its explore trigger goes on the stack.
In response B casts Shock targeting Merfolk Branchwalker, tapping Mountain; Shock resolves.
The explore trigger resolves: A reveals the top card of A's library and, if it is not a land, puts it into the graveyard.

variants.label: killed_in_response
variants.expected: Merfolk Branchwalker dies to Shock and is in A's graveyard before the trigger resolves. The trigger still explores: Grizzly Bears is revealed and goes to A's graveyard; no counter can be put on Branchwalker. Wildgrowth Walker's trigger fires using A as the controller: Walker is 2/4 and A is at 23.

variants.label: no_response
variants.expected: Merfolk Branchwalker explores and gets a +1/+1 counter (3/2); Grizzly Bears goes to A's graveyard. Wildgrowth Walker's trigger fires: Walker is 2/4 and A is at 23.

variants.label: land_on_top_killed
variants.delta: The library order is Forest, then Grizzly Bears (Branchwalker still killed in response).
variants.expected: Merfolk Branchwalker is in A's graveyard. The trigger still explores: Forest is revealed and goes to A's hand. Wildgrowth Walker's trigger fires: Walker is 2/4 and A is at 23.

variants.label: trigger_countered
variants.delta: B casts Stifle targeting the explore trigger with Island instead of casting Shock.
variants.expected: The explore trigger is countered. Nothing is revealed, Merfolk Branchwalker stays 2/1 with no counter, Wildgrowth Walker's trigger does not fire (1/3, A at 20), and A's library is unchanged.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's ExploreEffect reads the card from the game state before adding the counter; the Explores trigger needs the last-known controller of the dead creature.

scenarios.title: Several permanents instructed to explore at once explore one at a time

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top card first. Both of A's Merfolk are on the battlefield before combat.

decisions: A moves to the beginning of combat. Hakbal's trigger (each Merfolk creature A controls explores) resolves.
A chooses Hakbal of the Surging Soul to explore first and Merfolk Branchwalker second. After each reveal, if the revealed card is not a land, A puts it into the graveyard.

variants.label: hakbal_first
variants.expected: Hakbal explores first: Forest is revealed and goes to A's hand, so Hakbal gets no counter (3/3). Branchwalker explores second: Shock is revealed and goes to A's graveyard, and Branchwalker gets a +1/+1 counter (3/2).

variants.label: branchwalker_first
variants.delta: A chooses Merfolk Branchwalker to explore first and Hakbal second.
variants.expected: Branchwalker explores first: Forest goes to A's hand and Branchwalker gets no counter (2/1). Hakbal explores second: Shock goes to A's graveyard and Hakbal gets a +1/+1 counter (4/4).

variants.label: only_one_merfolk
variants.delta: The second permanent is Grizzly Bears, which is not a Merfolk.
variants.expected: Only Hakbal explores: Forest goes to A's hand and Hakbal gets no counter (3/3). Grizzly Bears does not explore and Shock stays on top of A's library.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge sorts the exploring permanents by owner and lets the controller order them; both permanents share one controller here, so the order is A's choice.
